notes: An intersection at infinity has raw coordinates but no Cartesian drawing or hit target. Export: vertical increments omit expressions outside supported numeric arithmetic and Length of a named list.
Export: Writes native commands for supported named inputs and retained equations or inline operands for the other supported forms.
Export: Writes endpoint commands for named points. A fixed length uses a point on an anonymous circle and a two-point segment, with an inline start when the definition supplies one.
Export: Writes Ray with named inputs or supported inline operands. The command carries the start and the element carries the line coefficients.
Export: Writes start coordinates or a named or supported dependent point expression.
a circle is a conic upstream; the kernel keeps it as its own kind. Export: Writes supported center-and-radius and point commands and the computed circle matrix.

Empty real conics such as x^2 + 1 = 0 have no SVG or pointer geometry. The SVG view fits bounded conics. The importer accepts conic images under transformations and rejects free conics. Export: Writes the computed matrix and conic presentation. Supported dependent conics carry named-input commands or a retained definition.
Export: Writes native commands for supported point-defined arcs and retained definitions for supported conic-part forms.
Saved zero-opacity unhatched sectors only hit their boundary. Export: Writes native commands for supported point-defined sectors and retained definitions for supported conic-part forms.
bounded free numbers are sliders. Export: Writes per-bar image fills backed by supported archived rasters.
angles with drawable geometry have a sector or right-angle marker. Export: Writes saved angle style and the raw value of a free angle. Dependent angles use supported command definitions.
free booleans are canvas checkboxes. Export: Writes a checkbox element for a free Boolean and a supported expression for a dependent Boolean.

Freehand Function creates interpolated graphs and Function Inspector samples a selected graph. Single-variable saved functions with supported expressions. Export: Writes supported function syntax from the retained definition or journal, with modeled display and table settings.

Pointer queries cap shape preparation and vertex reads at 4096 units. Export: Writes Polygon for supported vertices and orders regular-polygon edges before generated vertices. History-dependent slot growth can change labels on reload. Kernel-only clipping slots are refused.
Pointer queries cap shape preparation and vertex reads at 4096 units. Export: Writes PolyLine for supported vertex definitions within the file argument limit.

Anonymous points and vectors and segments and lines and rays and circles and conics draw and can be picked. Named members keep their own drawings. Bare numbers and Booleans suppress list graphics. Uses up to 256 work units per list and 512 shared by desktop fit and paint or 4096 per SVG pass or pointer query. Anonymous circles and conics cost 64 units each. Create List accepts the supported rectangle shapes with at most 256 objects and 16 KiB of labels. Rectangle selection and filtering share 4096 units for candidates and shape preparation (including vector start dependencies) and vertex reads and journal operations. Exhaustion cancels the operation. Transformed shapes allow 64 preparation levels and clipped polygons need cached contours. Import rebuilds supported construction lists. Drop-down presentation is outside graphics list coverage. Export: Writes supported list syntax from the retained definition or journal. Saves modeled list properties separately.

The axes belong to the graphics view. Axis operands are reserved lines rather than recorded Axis objects. The SVG writer has no view decoration and the algebra view has no axis rows. Move Graphics View can resize an axis. Saved view settings retain separate axis visibility flags. The canvas uses a shared axes toggle. Export: Writes the view's separate axis visibility flags as settings in the archive.

Static and dependent texts with saved world or pixel placement and LaTeX typesetting. An empty text draws nothing. Export: Writes literal text or a supported dependent expression, with modeled placement and LaTeX settings.
LaTeX formulas use Text. The Text tool creates plain text and has no LaTeX option. Export: Writes a Text element with the LaTeX presentation flag and a supported text definition.

Desktop draws and picks the same first 10001 samples including isolated samples. The locus tool takes a path point or slider in either order with its dependent point. Export: Writes supported locus commands and the saved slope-field arrow flag. The kernel stores slope-field shafts.

Up to 512 intervals per plot draw clipped polylines. Cartesian replots cost four units of the shared 24-unit frame allowance or 12 while panning. Export: Writes supported CurveCartesian and transform commands. Line–curve intersections require contiguous labelled slots.

Polynomial equations and constructed implicit curves with import of saved matrices. Export: Writes the coefficient matrix and any supported defining command. Omits the original implicit userinput attribute.

Boolean regions use at most a 64 by 64 grid for up to two regions per desktop frame or eight per SVG across all layers. Numeric functions of two variables are algebra only in the 2D view. Import rebuilds supported saved expressions. Export: Writes supported retained expressions or command definitions. The expression type is `function` and the element type is `functionnvar`.

The Image tool inserts a local raster with two placement points. Raster corners and transforms have recorded cases. Saved fixtures cover PNG and JPEG and first-frame GIF. Export: Writes corner placement and archives the supported PNG, JPEG or GIF raster bytes.
Clockwise sectors with a world center and radius. Export: Writes slice image fills backed by supported archived rasters.

The canvas edits linked free numbers, angles, Booleans and text. The linked text preview is limited to 256 characters. The editor opens the full linked value up to 16384 characters and leaves larger values unchanged. The canvas uses its usual numeric format. Export retains position, length, rounding, font, symbolic mode, alignment and temporary input. Export: SVG and built-in icons are omitted because the asset store accepts archived rasters.
Caption and inert scripts are retained on import. Export: SVG and built-in icons are omitted because the asset store accepts archived rasters.

Frozen smoothed strokes retain cubic pieces and subpath breaks in saved files. The pen tool takes at most 512 samples per stroke and commits at most nine strokes per input frame. Each gesture creates its own object. Export: Writes PenStroke with its stored cubic vertices and subpath breaks. The reference applies arrowheads to slope fields.
